## Fresh Developments — Last 24-72h

**Signal 1 — DRAM Pricing:** Q3 2026 conventional DRAM +13–18% QoQ (decelerating sharply from Q2's +58–63% and Q1's +93–98%). Server DRAM same range; NAND +10–15% QoQ. Memflation still positive but moderating — PC/mobile OEM affordability walls emerging. _(TrendForce, July 3/9)_

**Signal 2 — HBM4 Ramp / Capacity:** **SK Hynix Q2 (July 29):** KRW 79.3T revenue (+257% YoY), record 76.3% operating margin — deliberately slowing HBM4 line conversions and pivoting wafers to DDR5 where margins approach ~90%; HBM4 volume delayed to Q3. **Samsung Q2 (July 30):** KRW 171.5T (+130% YoY), best-ever quarter; HBM4 sales >$1B, targeting >60% of HBM mix in H2; sees supply crunch deepening through 2028. **Micron:** all 2026 HBM supply committed; $50B Q4 FY2026 guided. No 2026 correction signal from any of the three majors.

**Signal 3 — Hyperscaler AI Capex:** MSFT Q4 FY2026 (July 29): Azure +41% YoY, crossed $100B quarterly revenue; FY2027 capex guided $255–260B — stock +14%, best single-day in years. Meta raised 2026 capex to $125–145B despite FCF compression (stock fell). Amazon $220B 2026 capex. Alphabet flagged 2027 capex as "significantly higher." Combined Big-5 ~$725B in 2026; Evercore/BofA model >$1T in 2027. **No guide-downs from any hyperscaler.**

**Signal 4 — AMD/Custom ASIC:** AMD Helios rack launched July 22 ($5.25M/rack, 72 MI455X GPUs + HBM4, first shipments late-Q3 2026). Azure, Oracle, OpenAI, Meta, Anthropic committed. AMD stock +13% July 29 on MSFT Azure catalyst. TSMC 3nm at 100% utilization, demand ~3x supply.

**Signal 5 — Optical/Photonics:** COHR: Q3 revenue $1.8B (record), Q4 guided above consensus → Q4 earnings Aug 12. LITE: Q3 +90% YoY to $808M, NVIDIA $2B investment/supply agreement, stock YTD +372%, 1.6T transceivers ramping. InP lead times extended past 2027 by NVIDIA pre-allocations. CPO ~0.5% penetration now, 35% by 2030.

**Signal 6 — Solar:** Wells Fargo raised FSLR PT $255→$320; Jefferies raised to $207; Section 232 polysilicon tariff ruling expected **early August** (proposed: $10/kg on China-sourced polysilicon, China = 93% of supply). FSLR +5%, ENPH +5%, SolarEdge +8% (July 6 catalyst). NXT earnings Aug 5; ARRY earnings Aug 11. **This is the single live binary catalyst right now.**

## Context vs. Baseline

- **Capex:** Baseline $600–700B → tracking ~$725B; 2027 >$1T emerging. Upward revision.
- **DRAM pricing:** Full-year tracking above baseline despite Q3 deceleration; Q1+Q2 both blew past forecasts.
- **SK Hynix correction signal:** Materializing as a strategic DDR5 margin optimization, not a price correction. Conventional DRAM margins approaching parity with HBM — this is the 2027 risk vector to watch.
- **AMD Helios:** Baseline said 2H-2026 — confirmed shipping late-Q3, on schedule.
- **Optical:** Demand outstripping supply thesis fully intact; NVIDIA pre-allocating InP capacity.

## Most Important Development

**MSFT +14% on Azure crossing $100B quarterly revenue** (July 29) — with FY2027 capex guided $255–260B and Helios rack deployments confirmed, this is the clearest single event validating the H2-2026/2027 AI infrastructure thesis. The largest enterprise cloud spender is materially accelerating. Combined with Samsung and SK Hynix posting all-time record memory earnings and no HBM correction signal in 2026, the baseline thesis is tracking above forecast on almost every dimension. The only nuance: SK Hynix's deliberate HBM4 slowdown in favor of DDR5 margin optimization is the earliest structural signal of potential 2027 HBM market dynamics — not a 2026 event, but worth tracking as all three suppliers complete capacity expansions.
